name: Inmocemento, S.A.
summary: Inmocemento, S.A., through its subsidiaries, engages in the cement and real estate businesses in Spain, the United Kingdom, Tunisia, the United States, and internationally. The company manufactures and markets cement and cement derivatives, including concrete, mortar, and aggregates. It is also involved in the leasing and management of office buildings, commercial and leisure premises, and shopping centers, as well as development and operation of projects for rental housing and residential use; and acquisition, development, and marketing of residential housing, as well as urban development management of land. The company was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Barcelona, Spain.
